investigator.method: Bounded Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC probe as part of BEATMAPPED-LONDON-SECOND-LIVE-TRANCHE-01 triage refinement: a single unauthenticated GET to the venue's official website (or official programme URL when directly given), no retries, no browser, no authentication, no challenge bypass, no state-changing request.

probe_history.reason: The single unauthenticated GET to the venue's whats-on page returned HTTP 403 with a generic hosting-provider access-control/WAF block page rather than any venue content, a legitimate boundary this investigation does not attempt to bypass.

identity.notes: The single unauthenticated GET returned an HTTP 403 hosting/WAF block page ("403 - Forbidden", noindex, a generic firewall-branded template with a Host-Header fingerprint), not any content attributable to the candidate venue; identity could not be assessed from this response.

reasons: The single unauthenticated GET to the given official_programme_url was blocked with an HTTP 403 response carrying a generic hosting-provider/WAF "Forbidden" block page, a legitimate access-control boundary.

Per policy, a BLOCKED outcome terminates escalation for this probe rather than justifying a bypass attempt; this candidate needs a later, separately-authorised retry, not further probing in this package.

evidence.description: Retained, bounded, contiguous excerpt of the actual HTTP response body from the single unauthenticated GET, plus real response metadata (status, final URL, content-type); the excerpt substring is a literal transcription of the response but is wrapped in a JSON envelope with metadata rather than the full raw byte stream, so it is not itself the byte-faithful response.
evidence.method: curl -sL; descriptive research User-Agent; 20-second timeout; redirects followed; unauthenticated GET; no retry.
